title: Interferes with device's default function key combo

judgment.rationale: The reporter gave a specific two-way Caps Lock/Left Ctrl remap and Fn+F6 touchpad symptom, but the report is from PowerToys 0.68.1 and omits the laptop model and current-version status. No comments or linked fixes establish whether this remains reproducible.
evidence: The body says Fn+F6 toggles Caps Lock instead of the laptop touchpad while Caps Lock and Left Ctrl are remapped in both directions.
Disabling Keyboard Manager or exiting PowerToys restores the default Fn+F6 behavior.
The issue was filed on 0.68.1 from WinGet; there are no comments, assignees, or linked work.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the laptop model and a current-build confirmation using the already documented mapping.

fix_assessment.rationale: The only report is from an old build and the Fn-key hardware behavior is unspecified; confirm the device and current status before choosing a code path.

issue_context.summary: With Caps Lock mapped to Left Ctrl and Left Ctrl mapped to Caps Lock, the laptop's Fn+F6 touchpad toggle reportedly emits Caps Lock instead of toggling the touchpad.
known_information: Reported on PowerToys 0.68.1, installed with WinGet and running as administrator.
The default Fn+F6 behavior returns when Keyboard Manager is disabled or PowerToys exits.
The report includes a diagnostic attachment, but no current build confirmation or laptop model.
inferences: The laptop firmware may implement Fn+F6 as a key combination that interacts with the remapped modifier state.
issue_context.analysis: The exact remap is already documented, so the discriminating missing evidence is whether the behavior persists on a supported current build and which device/firmware produces Fn+F6. A generic log request is not justified.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live body and checked for comments, linked work, labels, and assignees.
The report is old and provides no laptop model; no active fix link was found.

information_gaps.information: Whether the same Fn+F6 behavior persists on a current PowerToys build and the laptop make/model.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes a current Keyboard Manager regression from a device-specific Fn-layer behavior already changed by later versions.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On the affected laptop, confirm the current PowerToys version, repeat the exact two-way Caps Lock/Left Ctrl mapping, and identify the laptop model and whether Fn+F6 still emits Caps Lock.

actions.label: Confirm current Fn+F6 behavior and device

comment.body:
Thanks for the precise mapping and Fn+F6 behavior, including that disabling Keyboard Manager restores the touchpad toggle. This was reported on 0.68.1, so we need to know whether it still occurs on a current build and which Fn-key implementation is involved.

Please share the laptop make/model and current PowerToys version, then confirm whether the same Caps Lock↔Left Ctrl mappings still make Fn+F6 toggle Caps Lock instead of the touchpad. This focused confirmation will establish whether the old report persists on a supported build.
